name: autocommit
description: Turns every turn Claude takes into a clean git commit: only the files that turn changed, a Conventional Commits message written by Haiku, a secret scan before every commit, undo and squash. Plus a band above the prompt with model, effort, context and commits.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, notifications and /commits (en or fr). Commit messages follow commitLanguage.

commitModel.title: Commit message model
commitModel.description: Model that writes commit messages and spots obvious bugs.

commitLanguage.title: Commit message language
commitLanguage.description: Language of commit subjects and bodies, for example English, French, German.

bugCheck.title: Flag likely bugs
bugCheck.description: Warn when a committed diff holds an obvious bug (debug leftover, broken reference, half-finished code).

autoPush.title: Auto-push remotes
autoPush.description: Comma-separated remotes pushed after each auto-commit, for example me/notes, github.com/me/dotfiles, or * for all. Empty: never push on its own (/commits push still works).

prePushCommand.title: Pre-push check
prePushCommand.description: Command run before any push; a non-zero exit blocks it. {root} is the repo, {files} a file listing the changed paths. Example: gitleaks git {root} --log-opts=@{u}..HEAD

bar.title: Band above the prompt
bar.description: full: model, effort, context, Remote Control, commits. compact: context and commits. off: no band.

maxFilesPerCommand.title: Max files per shell command
maxFilesPerCommand.description: A shell command that changes more files than this at once (a formatter, a codegen) is not auto-committed; an alert says so.
